importerChecks: Effective Unity default/active-platform settings and GUID/pixels, accepting harmless Unity metadata expansion; generation metadata SHA is provenance rather than a cross-import stability rule.
scope: Source hashes, output hashes, actual importer metadata, resource/script references, literal dimensions and native button ranges. Portrait archive table/checksum/decompression and every RGB pixel/reference are compared, following face/face1/face2/face3 precedence; source GetFace analysis is static, not native execution. Not Unity import, rendered text, physical input or audio.
